note: A frozen corpus + relevance judgments for the retrieval regression gate. Queries are the shapes a personal-KB user actually types: a couple of words, a name, a question fragment, CJK. `relevant` lists every slug a good result set should contain, most-relevant first.

corpus.body:
# Jane Doe

Jane leads the memory system work and owns the retrieval pipeline. She wrote [[projects/hybrid-search]].

# Robert Smith

Robert runs deployment and owns the Cloudflare Workers migration.

# Hybrid search

We fuse a vector arm, a full-text arm and a trigram arm with reciprocal rank fusion. Owned by [[people/jane-doe]].

# Vault import

Importing an Obsidian vault: the browser reads the folder, the server writes pages, wikilinks become edges.

# Postgres full text search

tsvector with the simple configuration cannot segment CJK text, so a trigram arm carries those queries.

# pgvector and HNSW

An HNSW index only helps when the query is a bare ORDER BY with a LIMIT. Adding a GROUP BY makes the planner scan every chunk.

# Hyperdrive caching

Hyperdrive caches read queries for sixty seconds and never invalidates them on write, so read-after-write returns stale rows.

# Cloudflare Workers

workerd forbids holding a socket across requests, so every query opens a short-lived client.

# Embedding models

Changing the embedding model or its dimension invalidates every stored vector. The meta row pins both and fails loud.

# No similarity floor

A nearest neighbour search always returns something, so a gibberish query still yields its closest pages. Any floor is model dependent.

# Soft delete

Deleting a page keeps its body and drops its chunks, so restore can rebuild the index and search stops degrading.

# One database driver

Node hosts pool connections; Workers opens one per query behind a binding. Same driver either way.

# Standup

Discussed the import flow with [[people/jane-doe]] and agreed to ship export at the same time.

# Reading list

Papers on reciprocal rank fusion, dense retrieval and cross encoder rerankers.

# Groceries

Oat milk, sourdough, two lemons and a bag of coffee beans.

# Car service

The sedan needs new tyres and the front brake pads replaced before winter.

# 记忆系统设计

我们决定自研记忆系统,替换掉外部引擎,主打个人知识库。检索用向量加全文加三元组融合。

# 中文分词问题

Postgres 的 simple 配置无法给中文分词,所以中文查询要靠三元组这条臂来兜。

# 部署到 Workers

Workers 上不能跨请求持有数据库连接,所以每次查询都开一个短命连接。

# Pricing review

Writes are charged because they embed; reads stay free so an agent loop is cheap.
